title: 第4幕我选择留下第5幕试炼之战
content_zh:
第4幕 我选择留下
“当然是有天理的，我是主神，我便是天理。”主神V用怪异的腔调继续说道：“其实我比较推荐这一种，对我来说很省事。你知道么，如果要是你参与了进来，那么因为你的特殊情况我和我的同伴们将不得不单独为你修改计划，这太浪费时间和精力了！
而且，选择退出对你也有好处，至少你还有一半的机会回到正常生活。而如果你选择第二种参加游戏的话，那么你的存活几率哪怕最乐观的估计也只有百分之十左右。你认为自己会成为这百分之十的幸运儿么？”
“百分之十……还是最乐观的估计……”
邢辰的立刻黑了下来。
“的确，能够活着完成游戏的人并不多，所以我希望你能够考虑清楚再做决定。”主神V说道。
低头考虑了片刻之后，邢辰突然抬起头来，眼中已经有了答案，盯着主神V认真的问道：“参与游戏的奖励是什么？”
听到邢辰的提问，主神V明白他这是倾向于选择进行游戏了，不由叹了口气，略带失望的说道：
“的确有奖励，如果你胜利的完成游戏，那么从游戏中获得的收益都是可以保留的。金钱、能力、地位、生命的延长等等所有你能够想到的一切！只要你能够从游戏中获得足够的金币和成就点数，那么即便是成为现实中的一国之王也是轻而易举的事情，凡是现实中能够用钱做到的事情你都可以在游戏里用极为低廉的代价做到，就算是现实中做不到的事情利用游戏你同样也可以做到。当你加入游戏的一刻起，只要通过了试炼哪怕一场比赛没有打，你的金钱也绝对不会比世界上任何一个富豪差。”
“原来如此，的确是相当吸引人的奖励，那么，为了得到这些我在这个天神游戏中需要做些什么呢？”邢辰又问道。
“Dota知道么？我们的这个天神系统需要你在Dota以及它的衍生世界之中完成各种任务，而我们将会一直注视着你们这些玩家的表现，你可以认为自己是一个职业选手，只不过效力的俱乐部层次要更高一些罢了，当然，奖励也要高得多。”
“Dota！？”如果说之前的事情他还能够接受的话，那么这回邢辰算是彻底的懵了，难道Dota的魅力已经上达天界了么！？
“不是Dota进入了我们的世界，而是我们进入了你们的世界，然后体验到了这款游戏，就像是你们进入网游中玩游戏一样，我们偶尔也会来到你们人界体验一下不同的生活。”主神再次对邢辰使用了读心术，然后回答了他的疑问，“这个时候，我们这些主神被你们这些人类所创造的电影世界、数字世界等等吸引了。”
邢辰点了点头表示可以理解，毕竟这种神仙微服私访的桥段无论是小说还是电影都不鲜见，实在值不得大惊小怪，只是主神这么虚无缥缈高高在上的存在居然会被电影、游戏之类的东西所吸引，这实在让邢辰有些出乎意料。
“没什么好奇怪的，你能想象如果你们人类开发的人工智能或者机器人有了灵魂之后，他们又会开发出什么样的‘电影’和‘游戏’么？”
邢辰认真的想了想，最后不得不摇了摇头——他实在想象不出来一群机器人或者没有身体的人工智能程序到底会搞出什么样的娱乐来。
“所以，这就是我们见到你们人类的电影和游戏之后的感觉，新奇，异常的新奇！在我们的世界所谓新奇是非常少见的，这让我们着迷！”主神V笑道，“于是，为了能够更好的享受这些，我们根据自己不同的爱好开始了不同的游戏，有人选择的是利用电影生成副本世界，而我们选择的是Dota。
平时你们这些玩家需要每个月至少要在天神游戏中打5局正规的Dota比赛，以此获得经验和金钱，当然也还有其他一些方式我就不多说了，到时候你自然就会知道，这种对战里除了异质型异能外其他异能均不能出现在比赛中，并且你所有的装备也会被锁定，我可不想看到开局就有辉耀的猴子这种严重影响平衡的事情发生。”
“的确，这样一来游戏便毫无公平和平衡可言了，很可能从开局就进入虐杀模式……不过，异能和装备是怎么回事。”邢辰奇怪的问道，“既然不能将一些异能和装备用在游戏的角色中，那它们又该怎么用？”
“通常的比赛你是用不上的，不过这种时候你们一般也不会死，因为这只是俱乐部内部赛，你们都是俱乐部的重要财产，即便损失也要损失在有意义的战斗中。

异能和装备真正能够派上用场的是在对抗赛中，那是由Dota衍生出来的战场，你可以将那里理解成无限世界中的一个世界，你们要在那里利用自己的能力和装备为活命而搏杀，只有更强力的异能和装备才能够保证你不是那百分之五十左右淘汰者中的一个。”
“对抗赛？那……”
虽然邢辰还想要知道更详细一些，但是显然主神V已经懒得多费唇舌了。
“好了，我已经说得够多了，要知道其他人可是会什么都不知道就被扔进游戏里，你也算得到了足够的额外福利，我们时间不多，所以告诉我你的选择。退出还是继续？”
邢辰心头一震，不由得吞了吞口水。
这简直就是他人生中最艰难的决定了，向左选退出说不定就会变白痴，向右选择继续更有可能在接下来的游戏中挂掉，无论哪一条恐怕都不是什么好选择。
不过，尽管是如此重大的人生问题，邢辰却没有花费太多时间去考虑，几乎瞬间便坚定的给出了自己的答案。
“我选择留下！我参加游戏！”
邢辰抬起头来直视着主神V，斩钉截铁的给出了自己的答案。
content_en:
Act 4 I choose to stay
"Of course there is a natural reason. I am the main god, and I am the natural reason." Lord God V continued in a weird tone: "In fact, I prefer this one, it is very convenient for me. You know, if you are involved, then because of your special situation, my companions and I will have to modify the plan for you alone. This is a waste of time and energy!
Moreover, opting out is also good for you, at least you still have half a chance to return to normal life. And if you choose the second option to participate in the game, then even the most optimistic estimate of your chance of survival is only about 10%. Do you think you will be one of the lucky 10%? "
"Ten percent... is still the most optimistic estimate..."
Xing Chen's eyes immediately turned dark.
"Indeed, there are not many people who can finish the game alive, so I hope you can think carefully before making a decision." Lord God V said.
After lowering his head and thinking for a moment, Xing Chen suddenly raised his head, with the answer already in his eyes. He stared at the main god V and asked seriously: "What is the reward for participating in the game?"
After hearing Xing Chen's question, Lord God V understood that he was leaning towards playing the game. He couldn't help but sigh and said with a hint of disappointment:
"There are indeed rewards. If you complete the game successfully, you can keep all the benefits you get from the game. Money, abilities, status, life extension, and everything you can think of! As long as you can get enough gold coins and achievement points from the game, it will be easy to become the king of a country in reality. Everything that can be done with money in reality can be done in the game at an extremely low cost. Even things that cannot be done in reality can be done by using the game. From the moment you join the game, as long as you pass the trial, even if you don’t play a game, your money will definitely not be worse than that of any rich man in the world.”
"So, it is indeed a very attractive reward. So, what do I need to do in this god game to get these?" Xing Chen asked again.
"Do you know Dota? Our god system requires you to complete various tasks in Dota and its derivative worlds, and we will always watch the performance of you players. You can consider yourself a professional player, but the club you play for is at a higher level. Of course, the rewards are much higher."
"Dota!?" If he could still accept what happened before, then this time Xing Chen was completely confused. Could it be that the charm of Dota has reached the heaven! ?
"It's not that Dota entered our world, but we entered your world and experienced this game. Just like you enter and play online games, we occasionally come to your human world to experience a different life." The Lord God once again used mind reading on Xing Chen, and then answered his question, "At this time, we Lord Gods are attracted by the movie world, digital world, etc. created by you humans."
Xing Chen nodded and said that it was understandable. After all, this kind of plot of private visits by gods in private is not uncommon in novels or movies. It is really not worth making a fuss about. It's just that such an ethereal and aloof existence as the main god would be attracted by movies, games and the like, which really surprised Xing Chen.
"It's nothing surprising. Can you imagine what kind of 'movies' and 'games' they would develop if the artificial intelligence or robots developed by you humans had souls?"
Xing Chen thought about it seriously, and finally had to shake his head - he really couldn't imagine what kind of entertainment a group of robots or bodyless artificial intelligence programs would create.
"So, this is what weThe feeling after seeing your human movies and games is novel, extremely novel! Novelty is so rare in our world that it fascinates us! "Lord God V smiled and said, "So, in order to enjoy these better, we started different games according to our different hobbies. Some people chose to use movies to generate replica worlds, but we chose Dota.
Normally, you players need to play at least 5 regular Dota games in Tianshen Games every month to gain experience and money. Of course, there are other ways that I won’t go into. You will naturally know by then that in this kind of battle, except for heterogeneous abilities, other abilities cannot appear in the game, and all your equipment will also be locked. I don’t want to see things like the Glory Monkey at the beginning that seriously affect the balance. "
“Indeed, in this way, the game will be completely unfair and balanced, and it is likely to enter the killing mode from the beginning... But what about the superpowers and equipment? "Xing Chen asked strangely, "Since some abilities and equipment cannot be used in the characters in the game, how should they be used? "
"You won't be able to use it in normal games, but you won't die in this case, because this is just an internal club game, and you are all important assets of the club. Even if you lose, you will lose it in a meaningful battle.
Where superpowers and equipment can really come in handy is in the competition, which is a battlefield derived from Dota. You can think of it as a world in an infinite world, where you have to use your own abilities and equipment to fight for your life. Only more powerful superpowers and equipment can ensure that you are not one of the 50% or so eliminated. "
"Contest? Then..."
Although Xing Chen still wanted to know more details, it was obvious that Lord God V was too lazy to waste any more words.
"Okay, I've said enough. You have to know that other people will be thrown into the game without knowing anything. You have received enough extra benefits. We don't have much time, so tell me your choice. Quit or continue? "
Xing Chen's heart was shocked and he couldn't help but swallow his saliva.
This is simply the most difficult decision in his life. If he chooses to quit, he might become an idiot. If he chooses to continue, he is more likely to die in the next game. Either way is probably not a good choice.
However, despite such a major life question, Xing Chen didn't spend much time thinking about it and firmly gave his answer almost instantly.
"I choose to stay! I'm in the game! "
Xing Chen raised his head and looked directly at the main god V, and gave his answer decisively.
